mapper.sql: SELECT 'PREPARATION_REFERENCE' AS binding,r.version_id AS binding_id,NULL AS task_id,'PREPARATION' AS domain, r.item_id AS target_id,r.version_id AS target_version_id,v.version_number AS target_version_number, NULL AS target_revision,v.title AS target_title FROM preparation_material_reference r LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.item_id=r.item_id AND v.id=r.version_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.excerpt_id=#{excerptId} UNION ALL SELECT 'QUESTION_ADOPTION',s.task_id,s.task_id,'QUESTION',d.target_question_id,d.target_version_id,v.version_number,NULL,v.title FROM ai_material_draft_source s JOIN ai_question_decision d ON d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.question_id=d.target_question_id AND v.id=d.target_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{excerptId} AND d.status='ADOPTED' UNION ALL SELECT 'FACT_ADOPTION',s.task_id,s.task_id,'PREPARATION',d.target_item_id,d.target_version_id,v.version_number,NULL,v.title FROM ai_fact_draft_material s JOIN ai_fact_draft_decision d ON d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=d.owner_id AND v.item_id=d.target_item_id AND v.id=d.target_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{excerptId} AND d.status='ADOPTED' UNION ALL SELECT 'RELATION_ADOPTION',CONCAT(s.task_id,'~',d.candidate_id),s.task_id,'RELATION',d.relation_id,NULL,NULL,NULL, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(d.content_json,'$.type')) FROM ai_relation_evidence_material s JOIN ai_relation_decision d ON d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{excerptId} AND d.status='ADOPTED' UNION ALL SELECT 'RELATION_EVIDENCE',s.evidence_id,NULL,'RELATION',e.relation_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,e.relation_type FROM knowledge_relation_evidence_material s LEFT JOIN knowledge_relation_evidence e ON e.owner_id=s.owner_id AND e.id=s.evidence_id AND e.source_kind='MATERIAL' WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{excerptId} UNION ALL SELECT 'REVIEW_EVIDENCE',CONCAT(s.review_id,'~',s.revision,'~',s.evidence_id),NULL,'STANDARD_REVIEW', s.review_id,NULL,NULL,s.revision,q.title FROM standard_review_evidence s LEFT JOIN standard_review_revision r ON r.owner_id=s.owner_id AND r.review_id=s.review_id AND r.revision=s.revision LEFT JOIN question_version q ON q.owner_id=r.owner_id AND q.question_id=r.question_id AND q.id=r.question_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{excerptId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () dependencies ORDER BY binding,binding_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT owner_id,id,purpose,status,manifest_json,manifest_hash FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{taskId}

choose.when: SELECT 'RELATION' AS domain,id,NULL AS version_id,NULL AS version_number,NULL AS revision,'ACTIVE' AS status,relation_type AS title FROM knowledge_relation WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{targetId}

SELECT 'STANDARD_REVIEW' AS domain,r.id,NULL AS version_id,NULL AS version_number,r.revision,r.status,v.title FROM standard_review r LEFT JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.question_id=r.question_id AND v.id=r.question_version_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{targetId}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS domain,NULL AS id,NULL AS version_id,NULL AS version_number,NULL AS revision,NULL AS status,NULL AS title WHERE 1=0

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_dependency_impact WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{impactId}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_dependency_impact i WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.domain=#{domain} AND i.target_id=#{targetId} AND (
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.question_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
1=1
) AND (i.revision=0 OR i.created_at>=#{baseline} OR i.decided_at>=#{baseline}))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_item i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id JOIN knowledge_draft d ON d.item_id=i.id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId} AND BINARY v.title=BINARY d.title AND BINARY v.body=BINARY d.body)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_usage_status_event i JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle_event e ON e.owner_id=i.owner_id AND e.id=i.event_id AND e.excerpt_id=i.excerpt_id AND e.created_at=i.created_at AND e.action IN ('ARCHIVE','RESTORE') JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle current ON current.owner_id=i.owner_id AND current.excerpt_id=i.excerpt_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.domain=#{domain} AND i.target_id=#{targetId} AND
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.question_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_version v WHERE v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_id AND v.id=#{versionId} AND v.version_number>=i.target_version_number)
1=1
AND (current.status='ARCHIVED' OR i.created_at>=#{baseline}))
